title: The numerical spacetime enclosing-area inequality in every dimension
exact_target: For every $n\geq 3$, consider smooth complete one-ended asymptotically Euclidean initial-data exteriors with integrable constraint densities, DEC, finite ADM limits, weakly future-trapped compact boundary, $g-\delta =O_6(r^{-q})$, $K=O_5(r^{-1-q})$, $(n-2)/2<q<n-2$, $E>|P|$ and positive full minimum enclosing area $A_min$. Is $\operatorname{sqrt}(E^2-|P|^2)\geq (1/2)(A_min/\omega _{n-1})^((n-2)/(n-1))$?
